title: US ground stop delays flights from Incheon Airport
caption:
A major communications outage at US air traffic control centers forced a nationwide ground stop, delaying international flights from Incheon Airport by two hours. Officials have confirmed there is no evidence of malicious activity behind the system failure.

Source: Koreaherald - US ground stop delays flights from Incheon Airport
